Executive Order
SOUTH DAKOTA
It is hereby ordered that Executive order No. 3748 of October 23 , 1922 , with￾drawing certain lands in South Dakota for classification , be and it is hereby revoked
in so far as it affects the public lands in the following described areas :
Black Hills Meridian
In T. 2 S. , R. 15 E., Secs. 1 to 12 , inclusive, N½ Sec . 18 , SE SE Sec . 34 , S
SW and SW SE1 Sec . 35;
In T. 3 S. , R. 15 E., Secs . 1 and 2 , NE NEI , SA NE and NE SE Sec . 3 ,
W W Sec . 6, all Sec . 7, SW NW and NW SW1 Sec . 8, N , E SW
and SE Sec. 11 , Secs . 12 , 13 , NE , NE NW , S½ NW + and S½ Sec . 14,
SE NE and S½ Sec . 15 , S½ S+ Sec . 19 , all Secs . 20 to 36 , inclusive ;
In T. 2 S. , R. 16 E., Secs . 1 to 15 , inclusive, 22, 23, 24, 25 , N , E SW and
SE Sec . 26 , NE1 Sec . 27 , S½ NE1, NW1 and SE1 Sec . 31 , S1 NW1 and
S Sec . 32 , S½ Sec. 33 , W SW Sec . 34 , E Sec . 35, all Sec . 36 ;
In T. 3 S. , R. 16 E., N Sec. 1 , S1 NE1 , NW1 NW1 , S1 NW1 and St Sec . 3 ,
Secs . 4 to 10 , inclusive, SW1 NE1 , NW1 and S½ Sec . 11 , SW SW1 Sec .
12 , S NE , NW1 and S½ Sec . 13 , Secs . 14 to 36 , inclusive ;
In T. 3 S. , R. 17 E. , Secs . 1 to 5, inclusive , N¹ , E SW1 and SE Sec . 6, NE
and NE NW1 Sec . 7, N and NE SE1 Sec . 8, all Sec . 9, N NE and
NW+ Sec . 10 , NE , N1 NW1 , SE1 NW1 and NW1 SE + Sec . 11 , N and
N SE Sec . 12, SW1 and W SE1 Sec . 17, E NE and S½ Sec . 19 , W
E and W Sec . 20, E and E W Sec . 22, all Sec . 23 , NW1 NW , S
NW and S Sec . 24, all Secs . 25 and 26 , NE1, E NW1 and S Sec . 27 ,
S Sec . 28 , W¹ NE1 , NW1 and S½ Sec . 29 , all Secs . 30 to 36, inclusive ;
In T. 3 S., R. 18 E., Secs . 1 to 12 , inclusive , W+ E and W+ Sec. 13 , N , E
SW1 and SE + Sec . 14 , N Sec . 15 , S½ SW + Sec . 19 , N NE and E NW+
Sec . 23 , N NW1 Sec . 24 , S½ S½ Sec. 28 , SW1 SW + and SE + SE + Sec . 29 ,
all Secs . 30 to 36, inclusive ;
In T. 3 S., R. 19 E., Secs . 1 to 17, inclusive , E Sec . 18 , N NE and SE NE
Sec . 19 , Secs . 20 to 31 , inclusive , WE , SE SE and W1 Sec . 32 , N
NW1 , SE NW1 and E Sec . 33 , all Secs . 34, 35 and 36 .

Signed by President Warren G. Harding Monday, October 23, 1922

585755Executive Order 3748 — Withdrawing Land in South Dakota for Classification and Pending Legislation for its Disposition1922President of the United States

Under authority of the act of Congress approved June 25, 1910 (36 Stat., 847), as amended by the act of August 24, 1912 (37 Stat., 497), all of the vacant public lands lying and being within townships two and three south, ranges fifteen and sixteen east, and township three south, ranges seventeen, eighteen, and nineteen east of the Black Hills meridian, in the State of South Dakota are hereby temporarily withdrawn, subject to the conditions, provisions, and limitations of said acts, for the purpose of classifying said lands and pending enactment of appropriate legislation for their proper disposition;

Provided, That this withdrawal shall not prevent or preclude the use of these lands, or any of them, for grazing or other analogous purposes temporary in character and not inconsistent with the purpose of this order.

Warren G. Harding

The White House,

October 23, 1922.
